name: GitLab
description: A web-based DevOps lifecycle tool that provides a Git repository manager providing wiki, issue-tracking, and CI/CD pipeline features.

tools.name: Add Group Member
tools.description: Add one or more direct group members by user ID or username. Billable role promotions may be queued for administrator approval rather than granted immediately.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Group ID or unencoded group path.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID or comma-separated user IDs; required unless username is supplied.

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: Username or comma-separated usernames; required unless user_id is supplied.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Expiration date in YEAR-MONTH-DAY format.

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: Guest 10, Planner 15, Reporter 20, Security Manager 25, Developer 30, Maintainer 40, Owner 50. Minimal access 5 requires a top-level group on Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: invite_source
inputs.about: Source of the invitation that starts member creation.

inputs.name: member_role_id
inputs.about: Custom member role ID (Ultimate only).

tools.name: Add Project Member
tools.description: Add one or more direct project members by user ID or username. Role promotions may be queued for administrator approval instead of granting membership immediately.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID or comma-separated user IDs; required unless username is supplied.

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: Username or comma-separated usernames; required unless user_id is supplied.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Expiration date in YEAR-MONTH-DAY format.

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: Access level: Guest 10, Planner 15, Reporter 20, Security Manager 25, Developer 30, Maintainer 40, Owner 50.

inputs.name: invite_source
inputs.about: Source of the invitation that starts member creation.

inputs.name: member_role_id
inputs.about: Custom member role ID (Ultimate only).

tools.name: Add Spent Time
tools.description: Adds spent time to a GitLab issue for time tracking purposes. This action logs time against an issue, accumulating with any previously logged time. Use this action when you need to record time spent working on an issue, track billable hours, or maintain project time logs.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: A summary of how the time was spent.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.about: The duration in human-readable format (e.g., '3h30m', '1h', '30m', '1d'). Supports combinations of years (y), months (mo), weeks (w), days (d), hours (h), and minutes (m).

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Approve All Group Members
tools.description: Approve every pending user in a top-level group, its subgroups, and projects. Requires permission to activate group members and an api-scoped access token. This is a bulk access change that may consume paid seats. Review all pending memberships first; use only a group whose entire pending set is authorized for approval. For testing, use an isolated top-level group with disposable pending members, not an existing group's unrelated pending memberships. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#approve-all-pending-group-members.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the top-level group.

tools.name: Approve Deployment
tools.description: Approve or reject a deployment on GitLab Premium or Ultimate. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#approve-or-reject-a-deployment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Whether to approve or reject the deployment.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.about: Comment to accompany the approval.

inputs.name: deployment_id
inputs.about: ID of the deployment.

inputs.name: represented_as
inputs.about: Name of the User/Group/Role to represent when you belong to multiple approval rules.

tools.name: Approve Group Member
tools.description: Approve a pending member for a top-level group and its subgroups and projects. Requires the Owner role for the group. Members pending because the user cap was reached become billable after approval. This is not administrator approval of a role promotion. The operation documents no additional plan restriction. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#approve-a-group-member and https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/manage/#approve-pending-members-for-a-group.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the top-level group.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.about: ID of the pending member to approve.

tools.name: Approve Merge Request
tools.description: Approves a merge request in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to record an approval from the authenticated user on a specific merge request. The authenticated user must be an eligible approver with appropriate permissions. Note that this action is idempotent — calling it multiple times on the same merge request will not create duplicate approvals.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: HEAD commit SHA for validation. If provided, the approval will fail with 409 if the merge request HEAD does not match this SHA.

inputs.name: approval_password
inputs.about: Current user's password, required only if project settings enforce re-authentication for approvals.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request to approve.

tools.name: Archive Project
tools.description: Tool to archive a project. Use when you need to mark a project read-only after finishing active development. Call after confirming no further changes are required.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to archive.

tools.name: Cancel Auto Merge
tools.description: Cancel active auto-merge and remove the merge request from its merge train. Requires GitLab 19.5 or later. Returns the merge request on HTTP 201; HTTP 403 means insufficient permission and 409 means auto-merge is not set. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#cancel-auto-merge.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Cancel Job
tools.description: Cancel a GitLab CI/CD job within a specified project. This action stops a running or pending job and is irreversible. Use this action when you need to cancel a job that is running, pending, or stuck in a canceling state. The optional force parameter allows cancellation of jobs that are in a canceling state. Once canceled, the job cannot be restarted.

inputs.name: force
inputs.about: Forces cancellation of a job in canceling state when set to true.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The ID of the job to cancel.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Cancel Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running pipeline in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to stop a CI/CD pipeline that is currently executing or queued. Note that the API returns success (200) regardless of the pipeline's state, so this action can be safely called even if the pipeline has already finished or been canceled.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: pipeline_id
inputs.about: The ID of the pipeline to cancel.

tools.name: Cherry Pick Commit
tools.description: Cherry-pick a commit onto a project branch, creating a new commit. Set dry_run to true to check whether it applies cleanly without committing. Conflicts and empty changesets fail rather than creating a commit.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: Hash of the commit to cherry-pick.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Name of the target branch.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.about: If true, test applying the cherry-pick without committing changes. Defaults to false on GitLab.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Custom commit message for the new commit.

tools.name: Clone Issue
tools.description: Clone an issue into a project, optionally including its notes. Copies as much data as possible when the destination has equivalent labels or milestones. Insufficient permissions can produce HTTP 400.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the source project.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the issue to clone.

inputs.name: with_notes
inputs.about: Clone the issue with notes. GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: to_project_id
inputs.about: ID of the destination project.

tools.name: Compare Repository Refs
tools.description: Compare two branches, tags, or commit SHAs in a GitLab project.

inputs.name: to_ref
inputs.about: Ending branch, tag, or commit SHA.

inputs.name: unidiff
inputs.about: Return diffs in unified diff format.

inputs.name: from_ref
inputs.about: Starting branch, tag, or commit SHA.

inputs.name: straight
inputs.about: Use a direct two-dot comparison instead of a merge-base comparison.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: from_project_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the project containing the starting ref.

tools.name: Create Board List
tools.description: Create one issue-board list by providing exactly one list selector.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project issue board on which to create the list.

inputs.name: label_id
inputs.about: The label ID for a label list. Provide exactly one list selector. Available on GitLab Free and higher tiers.

inputs.name: status_id
inputs.about: The status ID for a status list. Provide exactly one list selector. Requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: The user ID for an assignee list. Provide exactly one list selector. Requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: iteration_id
inputs.about: The iteration ID for an iteration list. Provide exactly one list selector. Requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: The milestone ID for a milestone list. Provide exactly one list selector. Requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate.

tools.name: Create Commit
tools.description: Creates a commit in a GitLab project with multiple file operations, including creating, updating, deleting, moving, and changing permissions. An optional force setting can overwrite the target branch with a new commit history.

inputs.name: force
inputs.about: When true, overwrites the target branch with a new commit history. Use with caution as this rewrites Git history.

inputs.name: stats
inputs.about: Include commit statistics (additions, deletions, total) in the response. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Target branch name where the commit will be created.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: List of file operations to perform in this commit. Each action represents a file change (create, update, delete, move, or chmod).

inputs.name: start_sha
inputs.about: SHA of the commit to start the new commit from. Must be a 40-character SHA-1 hash.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: author_name
inputs.about: Author name for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's name.

inputs.name: author_email
inputs.about: Author email address for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's email.

inputs.name: start_branch
inputs.about: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, uses the target branch.

inputs.name: start_project
inputs.about: Project ID or URL-encoded path of the source project for the parent commit. Used when creating commits from another project's branch.

inputs.name: commit_message
inputs.about: The commit message describing the changes.

tools.name: Create Commit Comment
tools.description: Posts a comment to a specific commit in a GitLab project repository. Use this action when you need to provide feedback, review notes, or discussion on a particular commit. Line-specific comments require both path and line parameters; if invalid, the comment is placed at the commit level.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag.

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: The line number where the comment should be placed. Requires path to be specified.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: The text content of the comment.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The file path relative to the repository. Required if line or line_type is specified.

inputs.name: line_type
inputs.about: The type of line ('new' or 'old'). Requires path and line to be specified.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Create Deployment
tools.description: Create a deployment for a project's environment and deployed commit. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#create-a-deployment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Name of the deployed branch or tag.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: SHA of the deployed commit.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.about: Whether the deployed ref is a tag.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Status of the deployment to create.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: Name of the deployment environment.

tools.name: Create Environment
tools.description: Create an environment in a project, optionally associating Kubernetes resources. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#create-an-environment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the environment.

inputs.name: tier
inputs.about: Deployment tier of the new environment.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the environment.

inputs.name: external_url
inputs.about: URL to link to for this environment.

inputs.name: cluster_agent_id
inputs.about: Cluster agent ID to associate with this environment.

inputs.name: auto_stop_setting
inputs.about: Whether to auto-stop always or only with a stop action.

inputs.name: flux_resource_path
inputs.about: Full Flux resource path, for example helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2/namespaces/gitlab-agent/helmreleases/gitlab-agent.

inputs.name: kubernetes_namespace
inputs.about: Kubernetes namespace to associate with this environment.

tools.name: Create Repository File
tools.description: Creates a new file in a GitLab repository at the specified path with the given content. Use this action when you need to add a new file to a repository branch with a commit message.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: The name of the branch where the file will be created.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The content of the file to create.

inputs.name: encoding
inputs.about: The encoding of the file content. Set to 'base64' if the content is base64-encoded. Default is 'text'.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.about: The full path to the file to create within the repository (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/README.md').

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: author_name
inputs.about: The name of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.

inputs.name: author_email
inputs.about: The email address of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.

inputs.name: start_branch
inputs.about: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Only used if the specified branch does not exist.

inputs.name: commit_message
inputs.about: The commit message describing why the file was created.

inputs.name: execute_filemode
inputs.about: Whether to enable the execute flag on the file (for executable files).

tools.name: Create GitLab Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group in GitLab. Use when you need to establish a new group for projects or collaboration.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the group.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path of the group.

inputs.name: avatar
inputs.about: Image file for avatar of the group.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: The parent group ID for creating nested group.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: The group’s visibility.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The group’s description.

inputs.name: lfs_enabled
inputs.about: Enable/disable Large File Storage (LFS) for the projects in this group.

inputs.name: default_branch
inputs.about: The default branch name for group’s projects.

inputs.name: emails_enabled
inputs.about: Enable email notifications.

inputs.name: membership_lock
inputs.about: Users cannot be added to projects in this group. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The organization ID for the group.

inputs.name: duo_availability
inputs.about: Duo availability setting. Note: In the UI, never_on is displayed as "Always Off".

inputs.name: mentions_disabled
inputs.about: Disable the capability of a group from getting mentioned.

inputs.name: wiki_access_level
inputs.about: The wiki access level. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: auto_devops_enabled
inputs.about: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group.

inputs.name: share_with_group_lock
inputs.about: Prevent sharing a project with another group within this group.

inputs.name: project_creation_level
inputs.about: Determine if developers can create projects in the group.

inputs.name: request_access_enabled
inputs.about: Allow users to request member access.

inputs.name: subgroup_creation_level
inputs.about: Allowed to create subgroups.

inputs.name: two_factor_grace_period
inputs.about: Time before Two-factor authentication is enforced (in hours).

inputs.name: enabled_git_access_protocol
inputs.about: Enabled protocols for Git access.

inputs.name: experiment_features_enabled
inputs.about: Enable experiment features for this group.

inputs.name: shared_runners_minutes_limit
inputs.about: Can be set by administrators only. Maximum number of monthly compute minutes for this group. Can be nil (default; inherit system default), 0 (unlimited), or > 0. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: require_two_factor_authentication
inputs.about: Require all users in this group to set up two-factor authentication.

inputs.name: default_branch_protection_defaults
inputs.about: Options for default_branch_protection_defaults. E.g. {"allowed_to_push": [{"access_level":40}], "allow_force_push": False, "allowed_to_merge": [{"access_level":40}], "developer_can_initial_push": False}

inputs.name: extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit
inputs.about: Can be set by administrators only. Additional compute minutes for this group. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

tools.name: Create Group Variable
tools.description: Create a group-level CI/CD variable. Requires the Owner role for the group.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the group.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Variable key: at most 255 letters, digits, or underscores.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.about: Whether the value is raw text; defaults to true. False expands variables in the value.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Value of the variable.

inputs.name: masked
inputs.about: Whether the variable is masked.

inputs.name: protected
inputs.about: Whether the variable is protected.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Variable description; defaults to null.

inputs.name: variable_type
inputs.about: Variable type; defaults to env_var.

inputs.name: environment_scope
inputs.about: Environment scope. Requires Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: masked_and_hidden
inputs.about: Whether the variable is masked and hidden; defaults to false.

tools.name: Create Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Create a group wiki page with a title and content in a supported markup format. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#create-a-wiki-page.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title of the wiki page.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Wiki page format. GitLab defaults to markdown when omitted.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Content of the wiki page.

tools.name: Create Issue Discussion
tools.description: Create an issue discussion thread that can receive replies. Backdating with created_at requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Content of the new discussion thread.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the issue.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation timestamp; requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

tools.name: Create Issue Link
tools.description: Create a two-way relationship between two issues. The caller must be allowed to update both issues. Supports related issues, blocking, and blocked-by relationships.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the source project.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the source issue.

inputs.name: link_type
inputs.about: Relationship from source to target. GitLab defaults to relates_to.

inputs.name: target_issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the target issue.

inputs.name: target_project_id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the target project.

tools.name: Create Issue Note
tools.description: Creates a new note (comment) on a project issue in GitLab. Use this action when you need to add a comment, provide feedback, or document information on an existing issue.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project identifier: numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). Path must use forward slash / as separator. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The content of a note. Limited to 1,000,000 characters.

inputs.name: internal
inputs.about: Controls note visibility. When set to true, the note is visible only to project members with at least Reporter role. Default is false.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of a project's issue.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: Date time string, ISO 8601 formatted, for example 2016-03-11T03:45:40Z. Requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Deprecated flag for confidential notes; scheduled for removal in GitLab 16.0. Use 'internal' instead.

tools.name: Create Label
tools.description: Creates a new label for a GitLab project with specified name, color, and optional attributes. Use this action when you need to create a new label for organizing issues and merge requests within a project. Labels help categorize and filter project items, making project management more efficient.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project', or 'my-group%2Fmy-project').

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the label.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The color of the label given in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' sign (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color names.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: If true, marks the label as archived. Default value: false.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: The priority of the label. Must be greater than or equal to zero or null to remove priority.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The description of the label.

tools.name: Create Merge Request
tools.description: Creates a new merge request in a GitLab project to propose changes from a source branch into a target branch. Use this action when you need to create a merge request for code review, feature integration, or bug fixes. This action requires both the source and target branches to exist in the project.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title of the merge request.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to assign to the merge request.

inputs.name: squash
inputs.about: Squash commits into a single commit when merging.

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: The ID of the user to assign the merge request to. Use assignee_ids for multiple assignees.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The description of the merge request. Supports Markdown formatting.

inputs.name: assignee_ids
inputs.about: The IDs of users to assign the merge request to. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: The global ID of a milestone to associate with the merge request.

inputs.name: reviewer_ids
inputs.about: The IDs of users to set as reviewers of the merge request. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: source_branch
inputs.about: The source branch containing the changes to be merged.

inputs.name: target_branch
inputs.about: The target branch into which the changes will be merged.

inputs.name: target_project_id
inputs.about: The target project ID. Useful when creating merge requests across forks.

inputs.name: allow_collaboration
inputs.about: Allow commits from members who can merge to the target branch.

inputs.name: remove_source_branch
inputs.about: Automatically remove the source branch when the merge request is merged.

inputs.name: allow_maintainer_to_push
inputs.about: Deprecated. Use allow_collaboration instead. Allows commits from maintainers who can merge to the target branch.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Dependency
tools.description: Make a merge request depend on another merge request being merged first. Specify a global blocking MR ID or its project-local IID. For a blocking IID in another project, also provide blocking_project_id.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request to be blocked.

inputs.name: blocking_project_id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespaced path of the blocking project. Defaults to the current project; required for a cross-project blocking IID.

inputs.name: blocking_merge_request_id
inputs.about: Global numeric ID of the blocking merge request as a decimal string to preserve precision. Required unless blocking_merge_request_iid is provided.

inputs.name: blocking_merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the blocking merge request. Required unless blocking_merge_request_id is provided.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Create a replyable merge request discussion on the overview or a diff position. For added lines supply new_line only; for removed lines supply old_line only; for unchanged lines supply both. Use line_range for multiline comments.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Content of the new discussion thread.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Diff position; use the latest merge request version's base/head/start SHAs. Omit for an overview thread.

inputs.name: commit_id
inputs.about: Commit SHA to start this discussion on.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation timestamp; requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Creates and saves an unpublished merge request draft note that is visible only to its author. Use this action when the requested outcome is a saved draft for later publication; it does not publish a comment.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: Content of the unpublished draft note. Whitespace-only notes are rejected.

inputs.name: commit_id
inputs.about: Commit SHA to associate with the draft note.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: The project-local IID of the merge request.

inputs.name: resolve_discussion
inputs.about: Whether publishing this draft should resolve its discussion.

inputs.name: in_reply_to_discussion_id
inputs.about: Discussion ID to which this draft note replies.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Note
tools.description: Create a merge request comment, not a line-specific diff discussion. Emoji-only content can create and return an emoji reaction instead of a note. Quick actions in the body can also change the merge request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Note content, up to 1,000,000 characters.

inputs.name: internal
inputs.about: Whether the note is internal. GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation timestamp; requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

inputs.name: merge_request_diff_head_sha
inputs.about: Head commit SHA, required for the /merge quick action to guard against merge request updates.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Pipeline
tools.description: Create a detached or, when enabled, merged results merge request pipeline. This does not run a regular branch/tag pipeline. Configure .gitlab-ci.yml for merge request jobs (for example, only: [merge_requests]).

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local internal ID of the merge request.

tools.name: Create Milestone
tools.description: Creates a new milestone in a GitLab project. Milestones track progress towards a goal with a start date, due date, and associated issues. Use this action when you need to establish a new project milestone for organizing work, tracking release schedules, or planning sprints.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345' or 'my-group/my-project').

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title of the milestone.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: The due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputs.name: start_date

inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: branch_name
inputs.about: The URL-encoded name of the branch to delete. Cannot be the default or a protected branch.

tools.name: Delete Repository File
tools.description: Delete a file from a GitLab project's repository by creating a commit on the specified branch. You can supply author details and a last known commit ID to detect concurrent modifications, or specify a starting branch when creating the target branch.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Name of the branch where the file will be deleted.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.about: URL-encoded full path to the file to delete (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/readme.md').

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: author_name
inputs.about: The commit author's name. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.

inputs.name: author_email
inputs.about: The commit author's email address. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.

inputs.name: start_branch
inputs.about: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Used when the target branch doesn't exist yet.

inputs.name: commit_message
inputs.about: Commit message describing the file deletion.

inputs.name: last_commit_id
inputs.about: Last known commit ID for the file. Used to detect concurrent modifications. If provided and the file has been modified since this commit, the deletion will fail.

tools.name: Delete Repository Tag
tools.description: Delete the specified repository tag from a project.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Name of the tag to delete, without URL encoding.

tools.name: Delete Review Apps
tools.description: Schedule deletion of stopped environments in the review app folder. Defaults to a safe dry run. With dry_run=false, actual deletion takes place one week after execution. By default only environments 30 days or older are selected. Returns scheduled and unprocessable environment entries. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#delete-multiple-stopped-review-apps.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum environments to delete. Defaults to 100 on GitLab.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Delete environments older than this ISO 8601 datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Defaults to 30 days ago on GitLab.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.about: Defaults to true on GitLab: preview without deleting. Set false to schedule actual deletion.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Deletes a project webhook/hook permanently from a GitLab project, removing the integration and stopping all event notifications. Use this action when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or to clean up unused integrations. This action is irreversible — the webhook cannot be recovered once deleted.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: hook_id
inputs.about: The ID of the webhook to delete.

tools.name: Download Job Artifacts
tools.description: Download a job's artifacts archive or a specific report by job ID.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: ID of the job whose artifacts to download.

inputs.name: file_type
inputs.about: Artifact report type, introduced in GitLab 19.4. Defaults to archive (the full archive). Performance and browser_performance can return the other type if only that one was uploaded.

tools.name: Download Job Artifacts By Ref
tools.description: Download a named job's artifacts archive from the latest successful pipeline for a branch or tag. Requires a completed successful pipeline with artifacts. Optionally search recent successful pipelines. Parent pipeline artifacts take precedence over child artifacts.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: job
inputs.about: Name of the job whose artifacts archive to download.

inputs.name: ref_name
inputs.about: Branch or tag name, not HEAD or a commit SHA. For merge request pipelines, use refs/merge-requests/:iid/head.

inputs.name: search_recent_successful_pipelines
inputs.about: Search up to 100 recent successful pipelines instead of only the latest. Defaults to false on GitLab.

tools.name: Download Project Avatar
tools.description: Tool to download a project's avatar image. Use when you need the raw avatar bytes after confirming the project exists.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project whose avatar to download.

tools.name: Download Project Upload
tools.description: Download a GitLab project Markdown upload by secret and filename.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.about: The name of the uploaded file to download.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.

inputs.name: upload_identifier
inputs.about: The 32-character upload identifier from the GitLab project upload URL.

tools.name: Download Repository Archive
tools.description: Download a repository archive, optionally limited to a ref and subpath. GitLab.com limits this endpoint to five requests per minute.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: Commit SHA, tag, or branch. Defaults to the default branch tip.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: Repository subpath to download; empty means the whole repository.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Optional archive path extension. GitLab defaults to tar.gz.

inputs.name: ref_type
inputs.about: Ref type for sha: heads for a branch or tags for a tag sharing its name.

inputs.name: exclude_paths
inputs.about: Comma-separated paths to exclude from the archive.

inputs.name: include_lfs_blobs
inputs.about: Include LFS objects. GitLab defaults to true.

tools.name: Enable Project Deploy Key
tools.description: Enable an existing deploy key on a project and return the enabled key. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deploy_keys/#enable-a-deploy-key.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: key_id
inputs.about: ID of the existing deploy key to enable.

tools.name: Erase Job
tools.description: Tool to erase the content of a specified job within a project. Use when you need to remove job artifacts and logs.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The ID of the job to be erased.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Fork Project
tools.description: Forks a GitLab project to a specified namespace or the current user's namespace. Creates an independent copy of the project that maintains a relationship with the source. Use this action when you need to create a personal or team copy of a project for development, experimentation, or contribution workflows.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to fork.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the forked project. If not specified, the name of the original project is used.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path (URL-friendly name) for the forked project. If not specified, the path of the original project is used.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.about: The ID or path of the namespace where the forked project will be created. If not specified, defaults to the current user's namespace.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: The visibility level of the forked project. If not specified, the visibility of the original project is used.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The description for the forked project. If not specified, the description of the original project is used.

inputs.name: mr_default_target_self
inputs.about: If true, merge requests in the forked project will target itself by default. If false, merge requests target the upstream (source) project. Defaults to false.

tools.name: Generate Release Evidence
tools.description: Collect evidence for an existing release. Returns success, not a release object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#collect-release-evidence.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Git tag associated with the existing release.

tools.name: Get Commit Diff
tools.description: Retrieve a page of file diffs for a commit, branch, or tag in a project. Configured diff limits can stop pagination before all changed files are returned.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: Commit hash or repository branch or tag name.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number, starting at 1.

inputs.name: unidiff
inputs.about: Present diffs in unified diff format. GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Results per page (maximum 100).

tools.name: Get Commit References
tools.description: Tool to get all references (branches or tags) a commit is pushed to. Use when you need to find out which branches or tags a specific commit belongs to in a GitLab project.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: The commit hash.

inputs.name: ref_type
inputs.about: The scope of commits to list. Possible values are `branch`, `tag`, or `all`.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get Commit Sequence
tools.description: Tool to get the sequence number of a commit in a project by following parent links from the given commit. Use when you need to determine the order of a commit in the project's history.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: The commit hash.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: first_parent
inputs.about: Follow only the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.

tools.name: Get Commit Signature
tools.description: Retrieve a commit's GPG, SSH, or X.509 signature. Unsigned commits return HTTP 404.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: Commit hash or repository branch or tag name.

tools.name: Get Container Registry Tag
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for one container image tag in a registry repository.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Container image tag name, supplied without URL encoding.

inputs.name: repository_id
inputs.about: Container registry repository ID.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user. Use this action when you need to get details about the user who owns the authentication token, such as their profile information, permissions, and settings.

tools.name: Get Deployment
tools.description: Retrieve one project deployment, including its job and available approval summary. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#retrieve-a-deployment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: deployment_id
inputs.about: ID of the deployment to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Environment
tools.description: Retrieve a project environment, including its last deployment and cluster agent. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#retrieve-an-environment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: environment_id
inputs.about: ID of the environment to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Repository File
tools.description: Retrieves a single file from a GitLab repository at a specific ref (branch, tag, or commit). Returns the file content as base64-encoded data along with metadata like size, encoding, and commit information. Use this action when you need to fetch the contents or details of a specific file from a GitLab project repository.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Name of branch, tag, or commit. Use 'HEAD' to automatically use the default branch.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.about: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get File Blame
tools.description: Return commit attribution and lines for a GitLab repository file.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Branch, tag, or commit SHA containing the file.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.about: Full path to the file in the repository. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: range_end
inputs.about: Last 1-based line to include. Must be provided with range_start and be greater than or equal to it.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: range_start
inputs.about: First 1-based line to include. Must be provided with range_end.

tools.name: Get Group Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific group by its ID. Use when you need to get details of a GitLab group.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

inputs.name: with_projects
inputs.about: Include details from projects that belong to the specified group (defaults to true). Deprecated, scheduled for removal in API v5.

inputs.name: with_custom_attributes
inputs.about: Include custom attributes in response (administrators only).

tools.name: Get Group Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific group member. Use when you need to fetch membership information for a user in a group after you know both group ID and user ID.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID of the group member to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Group Member All
tools.description: Retrieve one group member, including inherited and invited memberships. Use when the group and user IDs are known and direct membership alone is not sufficient. Visibility of invited private-group members depends on caller access.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID of the member to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Groups
tools.description: Get Groups

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Return groups sorted in 'asc' or 'desc' order.

inputs.name: owned
inputs.about: Limit to groups owned by the current user.

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Search for groups by name or path.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Return groups ordered by this field. Use 'similarity' when searching to order by relevance score.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of results per page.

inputs.name: statistics
inputs.about: Include group statistics (admin only).

inputs.name: skip_groups
inputs.about: List of group IDs to exclude.

inputs.name: all_available
inputs.about: Include all groups the user has access to (admin only).

inputs.name: with_projects
inputs.about: Include project details in response (deprecated).

inputs.name: with_two_factor
inputs.about: Include groups requiring two-factor authentication.

inputs.name: min_access_level
inputs.about: Limit to groups with minimum access level.

inputs.name: with_custom_attributes
inputs.about: Include custom attributes in response (admins only).

tools.name: Get Group Variable
tools.description: Retrieve a group CI/CD variable by key. Requires the group's Owner role. Use filter to select an environment scope when variables share a key. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_level_variables/#retrieve-details-of-a-group-variable.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Group ID or unencoded group path.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Key of the group CI/CD variable.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.about: Filter by environment scope. Premium and Ultimate only.

tools.name: Get Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Retrieve a group wiki page, optionally as HTML or at a version SHA. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#retrieve-a-wiki-page.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Group ID or unencoded group path.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: Unencoded wiki page slug, such as dir/page_name.

inputs.name: version
inputs.about: Wiki page version SHA.

inputs.name: render_html
inputs.about: Return the rendered HTML of the wiki page.

tools.name: Get Instance Version
tools.description: Retrieve the connected GitLab instance's version, revision, edition, license plan, and Kubernetes agent server metadata. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/metadata/.

tools.name: Get Issue
tools.description: Retrieves a single issue from a GitLab project by its internal ID (iid). Returns comprehensive issue details including description, state, labels, assignees, time tracking, and task status. Use this action when you need to inspect a specific issue's current state, check its metadata, or retrieve detailed information before performing updates or analysis. Requires knowing both the project ID/path and the issue's internal ID.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project identifier: numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). Path must use forward slash / as separator. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Get Issue By ID
tools.description: Retrieve an issue by its global ID. Administrator access is required. This does not accept a project-local IID. For a project ID/path and issue IID, use Get Issue instead. Returns issue details and preserves tier-specific fields.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Global issue ID, not the project-local issue IID. Requires administrator access.

tools.name: Get Issue Discussion
tools.description: Retrieve one issue discussion and its notes without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#retrieve-an-issue-discussion-item.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local issue IID.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Issue Link
tools.description: Retrieve one issue relationship by project, issue IID, and issue link ID. Returns the source issue, target issue, and relationship type. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issue_links/#retrieve-an-issue-link.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local internal issue ID.

inputs.name: issue_link_id
inputs.about: ID of the issue relationship.

tools.name: Get Issue Note
tools.description: Retrieves a single comment (note) from a GitLab issue by its ID. Use this action when you need to fetch the details of a specific note on an issue, including its content, author information, and metadata.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: The ID of the specific note to retrieve.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the issue.

tools.name: Get Job Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single job by its ID within a specified project. Use this when you need to fetch specific information about a particular CI/CD job.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The ID of the job.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get Job Trace
tools.description: Retrieves the trace (log output) for a specific CI/CD job within a project. Use this action when you need to view the execution logs of a job to debug failures, check output, or monitor job progress. The trace contains the complete console output from the job execution.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The ID of the job.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get Project Label
tools.description: Retrieves a single project label by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to fetch details about a specific label within a GitLab project, such as its color, description, or associated issue/MR counts.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: label_id
inputs.about: The label's ID or title (name).

inputs.name: include_ancestor_groups
inputs.about: Include ancestor groups. Defaults to true.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Approvals
tools.description: Retrieves aggregate approval status for a GitLab merge request on any GitLab tier. Returns every approving user, even when an approval does not satisfy a specific approval rule. Use Get Merge Request Approval State instead when Premium or Ultimate rule-level satisfaction is needed.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: The project-scoped internal ID (IID) of the merge request.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Approval State
tools.description: Retrieves rule-level approval satisfaction for a GitLab merge request. This endpoint requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate and shows which users count toward each rule, not every user who approved. Use Get Merge Request Approvals for all-tier aggregate status and the complete approving-user list.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: The project-scoped internal ID (IID) of the merge request.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Diff Version
tools.description: Retrieve a specific merge request diff version with its commits and file diffs. GitLab diff limits may exclude file contents. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#retrieve-a-merge-request-diff-version.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: unidiff
inputs.about: Present diffs in unified diff format. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: version_id
inputs.about: Merge request diff version ID.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Retrieve one merge request discussion and its notes without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#retrieve-a-merge-request-discussion-item.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion to retrieve.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Retrieve an unpublished merge request draft note, visible only to its author. Does not publish or change the note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#retrieve-a-draft-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: draft_note_id
inputs.about: ID of the draft note to retrieve.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Note
tools.description: Retrieve one existing merge request note by its ID without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#retrieve-a-merge-request-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: ID of the merge request note to retrieve.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Notes
tools.description: Fetches one page of comments on a specific merge request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number to retrieve.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of notes per page (max 100).

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Raw Diffs
tools.description: Get raw diffs of files changed in a merge request. GitLab diff limits may truncate results.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request.

tools.name: Get Milestone
tools.description: Retrieves a single milestone by its ID for a specific project. Returns detailed information including title, description, dates, and state. Use when you need to fetch complete details about a specific milestone.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: The ID of the milestone within the project.

tools.name: Get Personal Snippet
tools.description: Retrieve a personal snippet's metadata, not its raw file content. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#retrieve-a-snippet.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID of the snippet to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Retrieve a project's pipeline schedule, including its last pipeline and owner. Variables and inputs are only returned to Maintainers, Owners, or the schedule owner. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#retrieve-a-pipeline-schedule.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Retrieve a variable by key from a project's pipeline schedule. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#retrieve-a-variable-for-a-pipeline-schedule.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Key of the pipeline schedule variable.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to get a single project by ID or URL-encoded path.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get Project Approvals
tools.description: Return project-wide merge request approval settings.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

tools.name: Get Project Import Status
tools.description: Retrieve the latest repository import state and failures for a project.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

tools.name: Get Project Languages
tools.description: Tool to list programming languages used in a project with percentages. Use when you need the project language breakdown.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

tools.name: Get Project Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member. Use after confirming project and user IDs to fetch membership information for a project member.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID of the project member to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Project Member All
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member (including inherited and invited members). Use when you need the effective membership info (including invitations and inheritance).

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID of the project member.

tools.name: Get Project Merge Request
tools.description: Tool to fetch full details for a single merge request when the MR IID is known. Use when you need to retrieve canonical metadata, description, state, branches, authors, and approval-related fields for a specific merge request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: render_html
inputs.about: If true, response includes rendered HTML for title and description.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request.

inputs.name: include_rebase_in_progress
inputs.about: If true, response includes whether a rebase operation is in progress.

inputs.name: include_diverged_commits_count

tools.name: Get Merge Request Commits
tools.description: Tool to get commits of a merge request. Use when you need to retrieve all commits associated with a specific merge request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request.

tools.name: Get Project Merge Requests
tools.description: Lists merge requests for a GitLab project, with filters including state, labels and milestones. Returns one page per request.

inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: wip
inputs.about: Filter merge requests against their wip status.

inputs.name: iids
inputs.about: Returns the request having the given iid.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1.

inputs.name: sort

inputs.name: view
inputs.about: If simple, returns the iid, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.
