inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. Use numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). URL-encoding is handled automatically.

tools.name: Merge Merge Request
tools.description: Merge a GitLab merge request immediately or enable auto-merge when checks pass. A successful merge is irreversible, and should_remove_source_branch can also delete the source branch.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: Expected HEAD SHA of the source branch. The merge fails if the current HEAD differs.

inputs.name: squash
inputs.about: If true, squash all commits into one commit when merging.

inputs.name: auto_merge
inputs.about: If true, merge automatically when all required checks pass.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the merge request to merge.

inputs.name: merge_commit_message
inputs.about: Custom message for the merge commit.

inputs.name: squash_commit_message
inputs.about: Custom message for the squash commit.

inputs.name: should_remove_source_branch
inputs.about: If true, remove the source branch after the merge.

tools.name: Move Issue
tools.description: Moves an issue from one project to another in GitLab. The issue receives a new IID and project_id in the destination project. Use this action when you need to relocate an issue to a different project, such as when reorganizing work or transferring issues between team projects. If equivalent labels or milestones exist in the destination project, they are automatically assigned to the moved issue.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the source project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project').

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue to move.

inputs.name: to_project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the destination project where the issue will be moved.

tools.name: Play Job
tools.description: Triggers execution of a manual job in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to start or run a job that requires manual intervention or has a manual status.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The ID of the job to play.

inputs.name: job_inputs
inputs.about: Custom job input values for the execution. This is a hash of key-value pairs.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: job_variables_attributes
inputs.about: Custom variables as key-value pairs to pass to the job.

tools.name: Play Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Run a project's pipeline schedule immediately without affecting its next scheduled run. Returns GitLab's confirmation message, not a pipeline object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#run-a-pipeline-schedule-immediately.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

tools.name: Create Support PIN
tools.description: Tool to create a support PIN for your authenticated user. Use when GitLab Support requests a PIN to verify your identity.

tools.name: Protect Branch
tools.description: Protects a repository branch in a GitLab project by setting access controls for push, merge, and unprotect operations. Use this action when you need to enforce branch protection rules to prevent unauthorized modifications or deletions of important branches like main, master, or release branches. Protected branches can restrict who can push, merge, force push, and remove protection.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the branch or wildcard pattern to protect

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project

inputs.name: allowed_to_push
inputs.about: Array of access levels allowed to push, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, deploy_key_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

inputs.name: allow_force_push
inputs.about: When enabled, members who can push to this branch can also force push

inputs.name: allowed_to_merge
inputs.about: Array of access levels allowed to merge, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

inputs.name: push_access_level
inputs.about: Default access level allowed to push. Valid values: 0 (No access), 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

inputs.name: merge_access_level
inputs.about: Default access level allowed to merge. Valid values: 0 (No access), 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

inputs.name: allowed_to_unprotect
inputs.about: Array of access levels allowed to unprotect, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

inputs.name: unprotect_access_level
inputs.about: Default access level allowed to unprotect. Valid values: 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

inputs.name: code_owner_approval_required
inputs.about: Prevent pushes to this branch if it matches an item in the CODEOWNERS file (Premium and Ultimate only)

tools.name: Publish All Merge Request Draft Notes
tools.description: Publish all pending draft notes belonging to the authenticated user on a merge request. Optionally add a summary note and set the review state without recording a formal approval. GitLab may normalize note bodies when publishing. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#publish-all-pending-draft-notes.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: Text of a summary note to add to the merge request.

inputs.name: internal
inputs.about: If true, the summary note is internal.

inputs.name: reviewer_state
inputs.about: Review state to set after publishing; does not record a formal approval.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Publish Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Publish one pending draft note as a comment on a merge request. Before publication, draft notes are visible only to their author. GitLab may normalize the note body when publishing. Returns success, not a note object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#publish-a-draft-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: draft_note_id
inputs.about: ID of the draft note to publish.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Update User Preferences
tools.description: Updates the current user's diff viewing and CI identity preferences. All three settings must be supplied together.

inputs.name: view_diffs_file_by_file
inputs.about: Flag indicating the user sees only one file diff per page.

inputs.name: show_whitespace_in_diffs
inputs.about: Flag indicating the user sees whitespace changes in diffs.

inputs.name: pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt
inputs.about: Flag indicating the user passes their external identities as CI information. Internal use only; do not expose to third-party services.

tools.name: Rebase Merge Request
tools.description: Enqueue rebasing a merge request's source branch against its target branch. HTTP 202 means queued, not completed. Poll the retrieve merge request endpoint with include_rebase_in_progress=true to check rebase_in_progress and merge_error. Requires permission to push to the source branch, including force push when protected. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#rebase-a-merge-request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: skip_ci
inputs.about: Set to true to skip creating a CI pipeline.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Remove Group Member
tools.description: Remove a user explicitly assigned a role in a group. This does not remove users who only belong directly to a project in the group. By default, direct memberships in subgroups and projects are also removed. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#remove-a-group-member.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID of the member to remove.

inputs.name: skip_subresources
inputs.about: Skip deletion of direct memberships in subgroups and projects. GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: unassign_issuables
inputs.about: Unassign the member from issues and merge requests in the group or project. GitLab defaults to false.

tools.name: Remove Project Member
tools.description: Remove a direct member of a project, not an inherited membership. Optionally skip subresource membership removal or unassign project issuables. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/#remove-a-direct-member-of-a-project.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID of the direct member to remove.

inputs.name: skip_subresources
inputs.about: Skip deleting the member's direct memberships in subgroups and projects. GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: unassign_issuables
inputs.about: Unassign the removed member from issues and merge requests in the project. GitLab defaults to false.

tools.name: Reorder Issue
tools.description: Reorder a project issue for manually sorted issue lists. Position references use global issue IDs, not project-local IIDs. Supply at least one reference. Each name identifies the neighbor that should be before or after the reordered issue, not a move-command direction.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Global project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the issue to reorder.

inputs.name: move_after_id
inputs.about: Global ID of a project's issue that should be placed after this issue.

inputs.name: move_before_id
inputs.about: Global ID of a project's issue that should be placed before this issue.

tools.name: Reply Issue Discussion
tools.description: Add a note to an issue thread, or turn a single comment into a thread. System notes cannot receive replies (GitLab returns HTTP 400). See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#add-a-note-to-an-issue-thread.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Content of the note or reply.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the issue.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation timestamp; requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion thread.

tools.name: Reply Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Add a note to a merge request thread, or turn a single comment into a thread. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#add-note-to-a-merge-request-thread.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Content of the note or reply.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation timestamp; requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion thread.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Reply Snippet Discussion
tools.description: Post a reply in an existing project snippet discussion thread. For issue or merge request threads, use GITLAB_REPLY_ISSUE_DISCUSSION or GITLAB_REPLY_MERGE_REQUEST_DISCUSSION instead.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The reply text.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: ISO 8601 creation time for the reply, e.g. 2026-10-29T12:00:00Z. Setting a custom time requires administrator or project or group owner rights.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: snippet_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project snippet that owns the discussion.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: The ID of the discussion thread to reply to.

tools.name: Reset Merge Request Approvals
tools.description: Reset all approvals for a specified merge request. Available only to bot users with a valid project or group token. Human users receive 401 Unauthorized, even with an otherwise valid personal access token. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_request_approvals/#reset-approvals-for-a-merge-request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local internal ID (IID) of the merge request.

tools.name: Reset Spent Time
tools.description: Resets the total spent time for a specified GitLab issue to 0 seconds. This action is irreversible — all previously recorded time entries will be cleared and cannot be recovered. Use this action when you need to clear all time tracking entries for an issue and start time tracking from scratch.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project', or 'my-group%2Fmy-project').

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Reset Time Estimate
tools.description: Resets the estimated time for a specified issue to 0 seconds. Use this action when you need to clear a previously set time estimate on an issue while preserving the total time spent.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Restore Project
tools.description: Restore a project marked for deletion before it is permanently deleted.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespaced path, such as group/project.

tools.name: Retry Job
tools.description: Retry a single CI/CD job, optionally supplying job input values. Returns the retried job. Trigger jobs require GitLab 17.0 or later. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/jobs/#retry-a-job.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: ID of the job to retry.

inputs.name: job_inputs
inputs.about: Hash of job input names and values to use for the retry.

tools.name: Retry Pipeline
tools.description: Retries failed or canceled jobs in a pipeline. Use this action when you need to re-run a pipeline that has failed or was canceled. Note that if there are no failed or canceled jobs in the pipeline, calling this action has no effect.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: pipeline_id
inputs.about: The ID of the pipeline to retry.

tools.name: Revert Commit
tools.description: Revert a commit on a target branch, creating a new commit. Set dry_run=true to check applicability without writing. Conflicting or already-reverted changes can fail.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.about: SHA of the commit to revert.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Target branch name.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.about: If true, check whether the revert applies without committing changes. GitLab defaults to false.

tools.name: Search Globally
tools.description: Search visible resources and repository content across a GitLab instance.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-based).

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort direction for ordered results.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Work-item types to include. Applies only to the work_items scope.

inputs.name: regex
inputs.about: Whether exact code search uses regular expressions. Requires search_type='zoekt'; GitLab rejects it with other search types.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: Instance resource type to search. Result fields vary by scope.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filter by state for issues, work_items, and merge_requests scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Fields to search. Only title is supported, for issues and merge_requests scopes on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Term to search for across the GitLab instance.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field used to order results. Title ordering is limited by scope and search type.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of search results to return per page (1-100).

inputs.name: label_name
inputs.about: Label names that every result must have. Accepts up to 30 names for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.about: Search backend to use: basic, advanced, or exact code search (zoekt).

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Filter by confidentiality for issues and work_items scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: exclude_forks
inputs.about: Whether exact code search excludes forked projects. Requires search_type='zoekt'; GitLab rejects it with other search types.

inputs.name: source_branch
inputs.about: Filter by source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: target_branch
inputs.about: Filter by target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: author_username
inputs.about: Filter by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items scopes with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: include_archived
inputs.about: Whether to include archived projects in global search results.

inputs.name: num_context_lines
inputs.about: Number of context lines around each match. Applies only to advanced and exact code search.

inputs.name: exclude_source_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: exclude_target_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: exclude_author_username
inputs.about: Exclude results by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

tools.name: Search Group
tools.description: Search resources and repository content within one GitLab group.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or path of the group. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-based).

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort direction for ordered results.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Work-item types to include. Applies only to the work_items scope.

inputs.name: regex
inputs.about: Whether exact code search uses regular expressions. Requires search_type='zoekt'.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: Group resource type to search. Result fields vary by scope.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filter by state for issues, work_items, and merge_requests scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Fields to search. Only title is supported, for issues and merge_requests scopes on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Term to search for in the selected group scope.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field used to order results. Title ordering is limited by scope and search type.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of search results to return per page (1-100).

inputs.name: label_name
inputs.about: Label names that every result must have. Accepts up to 30 names for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.about: Search backend to use: basic, advanced, or exact code search (zoekt).

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Filter by confidentiality for issues and work_items scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: exclude_forks
inputs.about: Whether exact code search excludes forked projects. Requires search_type='zoekt'.

inputs.name: source_branch
inputs.about: Filter merge requests by source branch when using advanced search.

inputs.name: target_branch
inputs.about: Filter merge requests by target branch when using advanced search.

inputs.name: author_username
inputs.about: Filter by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: include_archived
inputs.about: Whether to include archived projects in group search results.

inputs.name: num_context_lines
inputs.about: Number of context lines around each match. Applies only to advanced and exact code search.

inputs.name: exclude_source_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this source branch when using advanced search.

inputs.name: exclude_target_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this target branch when using advanced search.

inputs.name: exclude_author_username
inputs.about: Exclude results by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search.

tools.name: Search Project
tools.description: Search resources and repository content within one GitLab project.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Repository branch or tag to search. Valid only for blobs, commits, and wiki_blobs scopes; defaults to the project's default branch.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-based).

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort direction for ordered results.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Work-item types to include. Applies only to the work_items scope.

inputs.name: regex
inputs.about: Whether exact code search uses regular expressions. Applies only to exact code search.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: Project resource type to search. Result fields vary by scope.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filter by state for issues, work_items, and merge_requests scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Fields to search. Only title is supported, for issues and merge_requests scopes on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Term to search for in the selected project scope.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field used to order results. Title ordering is limited by scope and search type.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of search results to return per page (1-100).

inputs.name: label_name
inputs.about: Label names that every result must have. Accepts up to 30 names for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.about: Search backend to use: basic, advanced, or exact code search (zoekt).

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Filter by confidentiality for issues and work_items scopes; other scopes ignore this filter.

inputs.name: source_branch
inputs.about: Filter by source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: target_branch
inputs.about: Filter by target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: author_username
inputs.about: Filter by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items scopes with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: num_context_lines
inputs.about: Number of context lines around each match. Applies only to advanced and exact code search.

inputs.name: exclude_source_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this source branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: exclude_target_branch
inputs.about: Exclude merge requests with this target branch. Applies only to merge_requests with advanced search on Premium and Ultimate tiers.

inputs.name: exclude_author_username
inputs.about: Exclude results by author username for issues, merge_requests, and work_items with advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

tools.name: Set Project Approvals
tools.description: Update project-level merge request approval behavior.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: reset_approvals_on_push
inputs.about: Remove existing approvals when new commits are pushed.

inputs.name: selective_code_owner_removals
inputs.about: Remove only approvals from Code Owners whose owned files change. Setting this to true requires reset_approvals_on_push to be explicitly false.

inputs.name: merge_requests_author_approval
inputs.about: Allow merge request authors to approve their own merge requests.

inputs.name: require_reauthentication_to_approve
inputs.about: Require users to reauthenticate before approving a merge request.

inputs.name: merge_requests_disable_committers_approval
inputs.about: Prevent users who add commits from approving the merge request.

inputs.name: disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request
inputs.about: Prevent merge requests from overriding the project approval rules.

tools.name: Set Time Estimate
tools.description: Sets the estimated time to complete an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to set or update the time estimate for tracking project work. The estimate is specified in human-readable format like '3h30m' for 3 hours and 30 minutes.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.about: The time estimate in human-readable format (e.g., '3h30m', '2h', '45m'). Use 'h' for hours and 'm' for minutes.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Set User Status
tools.description: Sets the current GitLab user's status message and emoji, with an optional automatic clearing interval.

inputs.name: emoji
inputs.about: Name of the emoji to use as status. Defaults to 'speech_balloon' if omitted.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Status message to display. Max 100 characters; can contain emoji codes.

inputs.name: clear_status_after
inputs.about: Automatically clear status after the specified time interval. Allowed values: 30_minutes, 3_hours, 8_hours, 1_day, 3_days, 7_days, 30_days.

tools.name: Share Project With Group
tools.description: Tool to share a project with a group. Use when you need to grant a group specific access level to a project.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The ID of the group to share with.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Expiration date for the group share in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601).

inputs.name: group_access
inputs.about: The access level to grant the group. One of GitLab's access levels, e.g., 30 for Developer, 40 for Maintainer.

tools.name: Star Project
tools.description: Stars a project in GitLab, marking it as a favorite for the authenticated user. This adds the project to your starred projects list and increments its star count. Use this action when you want to bookmark or show support for a project. The operation is idempotent - starring an already-starred project succeeds without error.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to star.

tools.name: Start Housekeeping Task
tools.description: Tool to start the housekeeping task for a project. Use when you need to trigger manual maintenance or pruning on a repository.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: task
inputs.about: Type of housekeeping task to perform. `prune` triggers a manual prune of unreachable objects; `eager` triggers eager housekeeping.

tools.name: Stop Environment
tools.description: Stop a running environment, optionally skipping its on_stop actions. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#stop-an-environment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: force
inputs.about: Stop without executing on_stop actions when true.

inputs.name: environment_id
inputs.about: ID of the environment to stop.

tools.name: Stop Stale Environments
tools.description: Request stopping all environments last modified or deployed to before a date. Protected environments are excluded. Confirmation means the stop was requested, not that all environments have finished stopping. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#stop-stale-environments.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Stop environments last modified or deployed to before this ISO 8601 timestamp (for example, 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z). Must be between 10 years ago and 1 week ago.

tools.name: Take Pipeline Schedule Ownership
tools.description: Take ownership of a project's pipeline schedule as the authenticated user. Returns the updated schedule and owner. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-ownership-of-a-pipeline-schedule.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

tools.name: Transfer Project
tools.description: Move a GitLab project to another namespace. GitLab may complete the namespace move asynchronously after accepting the transfer.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.about: The numeric ID or path of the destination namespace.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace path of the project to transfer.

tools.name: Unapprove Merge Request
tools.description: Removes the approval from the currently authenticated user for a specified merge request. Use this action when you need to revoke your previously given approval on a merge request. The action requires the merge request to have been previously approved by the authenticated user.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request.

tools.name: Unarchive Project
tools.description: Unarchive a GitLab project to restore active use. Requires administrator access or the Owner role on the project. Idempotent: unarchiving an already unarchived project does not change it.

inputs.name: id

tools.name: Unprotect Branch
tools.description: Tool to remove protection from a branch in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to unprotect a branch, allowing unrestricted push and merge access. This action is irreversible in the sense that protection rules must be manually reapplied if needed later.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: branch_name
inputs.about: The name of the branch to unprotect, or a wildcard pattern.

tools.name: Unstar Project
tools.description: Unstar a previously starred GitLab project to remove it from your favorites list. Use this action when you need to remove a project from your starred projects. This action removes the star that was previously added by the authenticated user.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to unstar.

tools.name: Update Deployment
tools.description: Update the status of a project's deployment. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#update-a-deployment.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: New status of the deployment.

inputs.name: deployment_id

tools.name: Update Environment
tools.description: Update an environment's settings, without renaming it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#update-an-existing-environment. Omit a setting to leave it unchanged; explicit null removes supported associations.

inputs.name: id

inputs.name: tier

inputs.name: description

inputs.name: kubernetes_namespace

tools.name: Update GitLab Group
tools.description: Updates an existing GitLab group's settings and properties. Use this action when you need to modify group configuration such as name, path, visibility, permissions, or feature settings. Administrators can update additional settings like shared runners limits and IP restrictions.

inputs.name: id

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: The group's visibility level.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The group's description.

inputs.name: lfs_enabled
inputs.about: Enable/disable Large File Storage (LFS) for the projects in this group.

inputs.name: default_branch
inputs.about: The default branch name for group's projects.

inputs.name: emails_enabled
inputs.about: Enable email notifications.

inputs.name: mentions_disabled

inputs.name: wiki_access_level

inputs.name: auto_devops_enabled
inputs.about: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group.

inputs.name: ip_restriction_ranges
inputs.about: Comma-separated IP addresses or subnet masks to restrict group access. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: share_with_group_lock
inputs.about: Prevent sharing a project with another group within this group.

inputs.name: project_creation_level
inputs.about: Determine if developers can create projects in the group.

inputs.name: request_access_enabled
inputs.about: Allow users to request member access.

inputs.name: subgroup_creation_level
inputs.about: Allowed to create subgroups.

inputs.name: two_factor_grace_period
inputs.about: Time before Two-factor authentication is enforced (in hours).

inputs.name: file_template_project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project for file templates. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: enabled_git_access_protocol
inputs.about: Enabled protocols for Git access.

inputs.name: shared_runners_minutes_limit
inputs.about: Can be set by administrators only. Maximum number of monthly compute minutes for this group. Can be nil (default; inherit system default), 0 (unlimited), or > 0. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: prevent_forking_outside_group
inputs.about: Prevent project forking outside current group. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: unique_project_download_limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of unique projects a user can download in the specified time period before they are banned. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: require_two_factor_authentication
inputs.about: Require all users in this group to set up two-factor authentication.

inputs.name: extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit
inputs.about: Can be set by administrators only. Additional compute minutes for this group. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: auto_ban_user_on_excessive_projects_download
inputs.about: When enabled, users are automatically banned from the group when they download more than the maximum number of unique projects. Premium and Ultimate only.

tools.name: Update Group Member
tools.description: Update a group member's access level, expiration, or custom role. Promotions may be queued for administrator approval rather than applied immediately. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#update-a-group-member.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID of the member to update.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Membership expiration date in YEAR-MONTH-DAY format.

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: Access level: Guest (10), Planner (15), Reporter (20), Security Manager (25), Developer (30), Maintainer (40), or Owner (50). Minimal access (5) requires a top-level group on Premium or Ultimate.

inputs.name: member_role_id
inputs.about: Ultimate only: custom member role ID. If no value is specified, removes all custom roles.

tools.name: Update Group Member State
tools.description: Change a user's group membership state to awaiting or active. The change applies to all subgroups and projects and can allow access when a user is over the free user limit. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#change-group-membership-state-for-a-user.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: New membership state: awaiting or active.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID of the member.

tools.name: Update Group Variable
tools.description: Update a group CI/CD variable. Requires the Owner role for the group. Use filter.environment_scope to select the existing scope and environment_scope to set the new scope. Verify the selected scope exists with the retrieve endpoint first: GitLab falls back to another scope with the same key if it does not exist. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_level_variables/#update-a-group-variable.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the group.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Key of the group variable to update.

inputs.about: Whether the value is raw text; defaults to true. False expands variables in the value.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New value of the variable.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.about: Select the existing scope when variables share a key. Premium or Ultimate only.

inputs.name: masked
inputs.about: Whether the variable is masked.

inputs.name: protected
inputs.about: Whether the variable is protected.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the variable. GitLab defaults to null.

inputs.name: variable_type
inputs.about: Variable type: env_var (GitLab default) or file.

inputs.name: environment_scope
inputs.about: New environment scope. Premium or Ultimate only.

tools.name: Update Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Update a group wiki page's content, title, and optional markup format. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. Provide content or title (or both). Changing the title can change the page slug. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#update-a-wiki-page.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: Unencoded unique wiki page slug, such as dir/page_name.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Wiki page title. Required when content is omitted.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Wiki page format. GitLab documents markdown as the default.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Wiki page content. Required when title is omitted.

tools.name: Update Issue Discussion Note
tools.description: Update the content of an existing issue discussion note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#update-an-issue-thread-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Updated content of the note or reply.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: ID of the thread note to update.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: Project-local IID of the issue.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion thread.

tools.name: Update Issue Note
tools.description: Updates an existing note (comment) on a GitLab issue. Use this action when you need to edit the content of a previously created comment on an issue. This is useful for correcting typos, adding additional information, or updating outdated information in issue discussions.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The content of the note. Limited to 1,000,000 characters.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: The ID of the note (comment) to update.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

tools.name: Update Label
tools.description: Updates an existing label in a GitLab project by modifying its name, color, description, priority, or archived status. At least one of new_name or color must be provided to perform the update. Use this action when you need to rename a label, change its appearance, update its description, adjust its priority, or archive/unarchive it.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The new color for the label in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color name. Required if new_name is not provided.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: Set to true to mark the label as archived, false to unarchive. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: label_id
inputs.about: The ID or title of the label to update.

inputs.name: new_name
inputs.about: The new name for the label. Required if color is not provided.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: The new priority for the label. Must be greater than or equal to 0, or set to null to remove priority.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The new description for the label.

tools.name: Update Merge Request
tools.description: Updates an existing merge request in a GitLab project (title, description, assignees, reviewers, labels, state, etc.). Use this action when you need to modify merge request details, manage assignees/reviewers, update labels, close/reopen merge requests, or configure merge settings like squash or auto-removal of source branch. This action is idempotent and can be called multiple times with the same parameters.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title of the merge request.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to replace the entire label set. Set to empty string to remove all labels.

inputs.name: squash
inputs.about: Squash commits into a single commit when merging.

inputs.name: add_labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to add without affecting existing labels.

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: Assignee user ID. Set to 0 to unassign.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the merge request.

inputs.name: state_event
inputs.about: State event to perform. Use 'close' to close the merge request or 'reopen' to reopen it.

inputs.name: assignee_ids
inputs.about: Array of user IDs to assign. Set to empty array to unassign all assignees.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: ID of milestone to assign. Set to 0 to unassign milestone.

inputs.name: reviewer_ids
inputs.about: Array of user IDs to set as reviewers. Set to empty array to unassign all reviewers.

inputs.name: remove_labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to remove from the merge request.

inputs.name: target_branch
inputs.about: Target branch for the merge request.

inputs.name: discussion_locked
inputs.about: Flag indicating if the discussion is locked. Only project members can comment when locked.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Internal ID of the merge request to update.

inputs.name: allow_collaboration
inputs.about: Allow commits from members who can merge to the target branch.

inputs.name: remove_source_branch
inputs.about: Flag indicating if the source branch should be removed after merge.

inputs.name: allow_maintainer_to_push
inputs.about: Allow maintainers of the target project to push to the merge request branch (deprecated, use allow_collaboration).

tools.name: Resolve or Reopen Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a resolvable merge request discussion thread.

inputs.name: resolved
inputs.about: Set to true to resolve the discussion or false to reopen it.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: The ID of the merge request discussion thread.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: The project-local IID of the merge request.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Discussion Note
tools.description: Update the content of a merge request thread note, or resolve/reopen it. Set exactly one of body or resolved. An empty resolved value is a no-op. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#update-a-merge-request-thread-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Updated note content. Set exactly one of body or resolved.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: ID of the thread note to update.

inputs.name: resolved
inputs.about: True resolves the note; false reopens it; an empty string returns it unchanged. Set exactly one of body or resolved.

inputs.name: discussion_id
inputs.about: ID of the discussion thread.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project-local merge request IID.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Update the content or diff position of a merge request draft note. Draft notes are unpublished and visible only to their author. Omitted position is kept unchanged. This does not publish the note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#update-a-draft-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the project.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: New content of the draft note.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: New diff position; omit to keep the existing position.

inputs.name: draft_note_id
inputs.about: ID of the draft note to update.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project merge request IID.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Note
tools.description: Update an existing merge request note's content and optional confidential flag. This edits a published note, not an unpublished draft note or a diff discussion. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#update-a-merge-request-note.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the project.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: New note content, up to 1,000,000 characters.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: ID of the note to update; required in the URL.

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Deprecated confidential flag of the note; GitLab defaults to false.

inputs.name: merge_request_iid
inputs.about: Project merge request IID.

tools.name: Update Milestone
tools.description: Updates an existing milestone in a GitLab project, allowing you to modify the title, description, dates, or state. Use this action when you need to change milestone details, adjust deadlines, or close/reopen a milestone.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new title of the milestone.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: The new due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.about: The new start date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The new description of the milestone.

inputs.name: state_event
inputs.about: The state event to apply to the milestone. Use 'close' to close the milestone or 'activate' to reopen it.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project's milestone to update.

tools.name: Update Personal Snippet
tools.description: Update an existing personal snippet's metadata or files. Requires permission to change the snippet. For multi-file snippets, supply files with an action on each entry; prefer files over deprecated content and file_name. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#update-snippet.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID of the personal snippet to update.

inputs.name: files
inputs.about: File actions, required when updating a snippet with multiple files. Each entry requires action.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title of the snippet.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Deprecated: use files instead. Content of a snippet.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Deprecated: use files instead. Name of a snippet file.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Snippet visibility. The internal value is unavailable on GitLab.com.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the snippet.

tools.name: Update Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Update a project's pipeline schedule, which is automatically rescheduled. Only supplied fields are updated. Inputs accept strings, arrays, numbers, or booleans; remove an existing input with its name and destroy=true. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-a-pipeline-schedule.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Branch or tag, as a short name or full ref (refs/heads/main or refs/tags/main). Use a full ref if a branch and tag share a name.

inputs.name: cron
inputs.about: Cron schedule, for example 0 1 * * *.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the pipeline schedule is active; false deactivates it.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Named pipeline inputs to update; to delete an input, supply its name and destroy=true without a value.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the schedule.

inputs.name: cron_timezone
inputs.about: ActiveSupport::TimeZone or TZInfo::Timezone name, such as Pacific Time (US & Canada) or America/Los_Angeles.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

tools.name: Update Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Update an existing variable for a project's pipeline schedule. Supply value, variable_type, or both; omitted fields are not sent. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-a-variable-for-a-pipeline-schedule.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Key of the variable to update.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New variable value. Omit to leave the value unchanged.

inputs.name: variable_type
inputs.about: Variable type: env_var (GitLab default) or file. Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.name: pipeline_schedule_id
inputs.about: ID of the pipeline schedule.

inputs.name: merge_trains_skip_train_allowed

inputs.name: protect_merge_request_pipelines

inputs.name: restrict_user_defined_variables

inputs.name: ci_id_token_sub_claim_components
inputs.about: ID token sub components. First: project_path, project_id, job_project_path, job_project_id, source_project_path or source_project_id. Additional: ref_type, ref, ref_protected, environment_protected, deployment_tier. Version-dependent.

inputs.name: ci_skip_branch_pipelines_for_mrs
inputs.about: Skip branch pipelines for merge requests.

inputs.name: prevent_merge_without_jira_issue
inputs.about: Require an associated Jira issue for merge requests. Ultimate.

inputs.name: remove_source_branch_after_merge
inputs.about: Default new merge requests to delete the source branch.

inputs.name: web_based_commit_signing_enabled
inputs.about: Enable signing commits created in the GitLab UI. GitLab.com only.

inputs.name: duo_code_review_decisions_enabled
inputs.about: Enable GitLab Duo approvals and change requests. Ultimate.

inputs.name: resolve_outdated_diff_discussions
inputs.about: Resolve discussions on diff lines changed by a push.

inputs.name: mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches
inputs.about: Pull mirrors overwrite diverged branches. Premium/Ultimate.

inputs.name: printing_merge_request_link_enabled
inputs.about: Show a merge request link when pushing from the command line.

inputs.name: security_and_compliance_access_level
inputs.about: Security and compliance visibility.

inputs.name: only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds
inputs.about: Require successful jobs before merging.

inputs.name: ci_forward_deployment_rollback_allowed
inputs.about: Allow retries for rollback deployments.

inputs.name: ci_restrict_pipeline_cancellation_role
inputs.about: Minimum role to cancel pipelines/jobs. Premium/Ultimate.

inputs.name: container_expiration_policy_attributes
inputs.about: Image cleanup policy settings.

inputs.name: ci_push_repository_for_job_token_allowed
inputs.about: Allow job tokens to push to this repository.

inputs.name: allow_pipeline_trigger_approve_deployment
inputs.about: Allow pipeline triggerers to approve deployments. Premium/Ultimate.

inputs.name: warn_about_potentially_unwanted_characters
inputs.about: Warn about potentially unwanted characters.

inputs.name: ci_pipeline_variables_minimum_override_role
inputs.about: Minimum role to override pipeline variables.

inputs.name: external_authorization_classification_label
inputs.about: External authorization classification label. Premium/Ultimate.

inputs.name: only_allow_merge_if_all_status_checks_passed
inputs.about: Block merges until all status checks pass. Ultimate.

inputs.name: ci_allow_fork_pipelines_to_run_in_parent_project
inputs.about: Allow fork merge request pipelines in the parent project.

inputs.name: only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_resolved

tools.name: Update Project Deploy Key
tools.description: Change a project's deploy-key title or push permission. Supply at least one of title or can_push. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deploy_keys/#update-deploy-key.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: New deploy-key title. Supply title or can_push.

inputs.name: key_id
inputs.about: ID of the deploy key to update.

inputs.name: can_push
inputs.about: Whether the deploy key can push to the project. Supply can_push or title.

tools.name: Update Project Issue
tools.description: Tool to update an existing issue in a GitLab project (title, description, labels, assignees, state, etc.). Use when you need to modify issue details, close/reopen issues, or manage labels and assignments.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title of the issue.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to replace the entire label set. Set to empty string to remove all labels.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.about: The weight of the issue. Valid values are greater than or equal to 0. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: epic_id
inputs.about: ID of the epic to add the issue to. Valid values are greater than or equal to 0. Premium and Ultimate only.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: The due date. Date time string in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: issue_iid
inputs.about: The internal ID of the project's issue.

inputs.name: add_labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to add to the issue without affecting existing labels.

inputs.name: issue_type
inputs.about: The type of issue. One of 'issue', 'incident', 'test_case', or 'task'.

inputs.name: updated_at
inputs.about: When the issue was updated. Date time string, ISO 8601 formatted. Requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The description of the issue. Limited to 1,048,576 characters.

inputs.name: state_event
inputs.about: State event to perform on the issue. Use 'close' to close the issue or 'reopen' to reopen it.

inputs.name: assignee_ids
inputs.about: The IDs of the users to assign the issue to. Set to [0] or provide empty array to unassign all.

inputs.name: confidential
inputs.about: Set an issue to be confidential.

inputs.name: milestone_id
inputs.about: The global ID of a milestone to assign to the issue. Set to 0 to unassign milestone.

inputs.name: remove_labels
inputs.about: Comma-separated label names to remove from the issue.

inputs.name: discussion_locked
inputs.about: Flag indicating if the issue's discussion is locked. If the discussion is locked, only project members can add or edit comments.

tools.name: Update Project Member
tools.description: Update a project member's access level, expiration, or custom role. Promotions may be queued for administrator approval rather than applied immediately. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/#update-a-member-of-a-project.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User ID of the member to update.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Membership expiration date in YEAR-MONTH-DAY format.

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: Access level: Guest (10), Planner (15), Reporter (20), Security Manager (25), Developer (30), Maintainer (40), or Owner (50).

inputs.name: member_role_id
inputs.about: Ultimate only: custom member role ID. If no value is specified, GitLab removes all custom roles.

tools.name: Update Project Snippet
tools.description: Update a project snippet's metadata or files. Requires permission to change existing snippets. Multi-file snippet updates must use files, with an action on every entry. Prefer files over deprecated content and file_name. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_snippets/#update-a-snippet.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: files
inputs.about: Snippet file actions. Required for updates to snippets with multiple files; each entry requires action.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title of the snippet.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Deprecated: use files instead. Content of a snippet.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Deprecated: use files instead. Name of a snippet file.

inputs.name: snippet_id
inputs.about: ID of the project's snippet.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Snippet visibility. The internal value is unavailable on GitLab.com.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the snippet.

tools.name: Update Project Variable
tools.description: Update a project's CI/CD variable by key with a required new value. Use filter.environment_scope to select an existing variable when keys repeat; environment_scope sets the variable's new scope instead. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/#update-a-variable.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: Key of the project CI/CD variable to update.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.about: Whether the value is raw text. GitLab defaults to true; false expands variables in the value.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New value of the variable.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.about: Select the existing environment scope when variables share a key.

inputs.name: masked
inputs.about: Whether the variable is masked.

inputs.name: protected
inputs.about: Whether the variable is protected.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the variable. GitLab defaults to null.

inputs.name: variable_type
inputs.about: Variable type: env_var (GitLab default) or file.

inputs.name: environment_scope
inputs.about: New environment scope of the variable.

tools.name: Update Project Wiki Page
tools.description: Update a project wiki page's content, title, and optional markup format. Provide content or title (or both). Changing the title can change the page slug. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#update-a-wiki-page.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: Unencoded unique wiki page slug, such as dir/page_name.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Wiki page title. Required when content is omitted.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Wiki page format. GitLab documents markdown as the default.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Wiki page content. Required when title is omitted.

tools.name: Update Release
tools.description: Update a project release's name, description, milestones, or release date. Requires Developer access. Omitted fields remain unchanged; pass an empty milestones array to remove all milestone associations. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#update-a-release.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New release name.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Git tag associated with the release.

inputs.name: milestones
inputs.about: Milestone titles to associate; [] removes all associations. Group milestones require Premium and must belong to the project's group, not ancestor groups.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: New release description, supporting Markdown.

inputs.name: released_at
inputs.about: Date when the release is or was ready, in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).

tools.name: Update Release Asset Link
tools.description: Update an existing asset link for a project release. Supply at least one of name or url; optionally change the direct asset path or link type. Supported URL protocols are HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/links/#update-a-release-link.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded path of the project.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Link URL. Supply at least one of name or url.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Link name. Supply at least one of name or url.

inputs.name: link_id
inputs.about: ID of the release asset link.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Tag associated with the release.

inputs.name: link_type
inputs.about: Link type; GitLab defaults to other.

inputs.name: direct_asset_path
inputs.about: Optional path for a direct asset link.

tools.name: Update Repository File
tools.description: Updates an existing file in a GitLab repository. Commits the changes to the specified branch with the provided commit message. Use this action when you need to modify file contents, change file permissions, or update files in a specific branch. Note that if concurrent modifications occur (detected via last_commit_id), the update will fail.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Name of the branch to commit to. The commit is added to this branch.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The new content of the file.

inputs.name: encoding
inputs.about: Change encoding to base64. Default is text.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.about: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository (e.g., lib%2Fclass%2Erb or path/to/file.txt).

inputs.name: author_name
inputs.about: The name of the commit author.

inputs.name: author_email
inputs.about: The email address of the commit author.

inputs.name: start_branch
inputs.about: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, defaults to the value of branch.

inputs.name: commit_message
inputs.about: Commit message describing the changes.

inputs.name: last_commit_id
inputs.about: Last known file commit ID. Used to detect concurrent modifications.

inputs.name: execute_filemode
inputs.about: Enable or disable the execute flag on the file.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Updates an existing project webhook's URL and optionally its event triggers, SSL verification, and authentication token. Use it to change the endpoint or security settings, adjust notifications, or rotate the token; the webhook URL is required even when updating other settings.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The webhook URL to which GitLab will send HTTP POST requests when events occur.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: Secret token for authenticating webhook requests. GitLab includes this in the X-Gitlab-Token header.

inputs.name: hook_id
inputs.about: The ID of the webhook to update.

inputs.name: job_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on job/build events.

inputs.name: note_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on comment/note events.

inputs.name: push_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on push events.

inputs.name: wiki_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on wiki page events.

inputs.name: issues_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on issue events (create, update, close).

inputs.name: pipeline_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on pipeline events.

inputs.name: tag_push_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on tag push events.

inputs.name: merge_requests_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on merge request events (create, update, merge, close).

inputs.name: enable_ssl_verification
inputs.about: Enable SSL certificate verification when delivering webhook payloads.

inputs.name: push_events_branch_filter
inputs.about: Filter push events by branch name (supports wildcards). Only triggers webhook for pushes to matching branches.

inputs.name: confidential_issues_events
inputs.about: Trigger webhook on confidential issue events.

tools.name: Upload Group Wiki Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file to the uploads folder in a group's wiki repository. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#upload-an-attachment-to-the-wiki-repository.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the group.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Attachment to upload to the wiki.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Branch name; defaults to the wiki repository default branch.

tools.name: Upload Project Wiki Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file to the uploads folder in a project's wiki repository. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#upload-an-attachment-to-the-wiki-repository.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: ID or unencoded namespace path of the project.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Attachment to upload to the wiki.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.about: Branch name; defaults to the wiki repository default branch.

tools.name: Validate CI Configuration
tools.description: Validate supplied GitLab CI/CD YAML without creating a pipeline.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Branch or tag context used when dry_run is true.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The GitLab CI/CD YAML content to validate.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.about: Whether to simulate pipeline creation during validation.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

inputs.name: include_jobs
inputs.about: Whether to include resolved jobs in the lint result.

tools.name: Validate Credential
tools.description: Validates the authentication credentials by retrieving the currently authenticated user's information. Use this action when you need to verify that the API token or credentials are valid and active. Returns the authenticated user's profile details if credentials are valid.
